archetypes.name: Template 1: Archival Hero & Schematic Split
archetypes.description: Grounded cutout character with breathing animation, high-impact headline, dark vignette wash, and 2-column comparative schematic cards.
archetypes.bestFor: Introducing a public figure, contrasting two eras, or explaining rival factions.

defaultParams.COL1_DESC: One puts a person briefly on screen as an occasional participant.
defaultParams.COL2_DESC: The other builds an entire television format around their authority.

archetypes.name: Template 2: Geopolitical Map & Tactical Trajectory
archetypes.description: Continuous subtle Ken Burns zoom, dual split tactical route maps, central question banner, and 3 sequential cue-timed options.
archetypes.bestFor: Explaining global trade routes, military choke points, canals, borders, or historical turning-point decisions.

defaultParams.SOURCE_TAG: Sources: U.S. Dept of State · SCA Archives
defaultParams.QUESTION_HEADLINE: Which moment turned crisis into a turning point in world power?

archetypes.name: Template 3: Archival Document, Metric & Evidence
archetypes.description: Archival document card, transformation metric flow (Before ➔ After), speech-timed glowing highlight pass, and historical attribution tag.
archetypes.bestFor: Inspecting financial data, treaty terms, nationalization decrees, bank reserves, or court documents.

defaultParams.SOURCE_ATTRIBUTION: Sources: SCA Archives · Bank of International Settlements
defaultParams.DOCUMENT_SUMMARY: The concession enterprise was transitioned from joint foreign ownership into sovereign state control.
defaultParams.HIGHLIGHT_QUOTE: “The decision spoke directly to sovereignty and national economic independence.”
